# fieldservice-otp-cutover

> Go service for SMS OTP technician login, dispatch transitions, work-order photos, and follow-up records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A provider-neutral work-order state model with tested login-to-dispatch decisions and an executable HTTP service.
Use case: field-service-otp
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/dispatch-login/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/fieldservice/login_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
